entity: Town-hall public-works tenders in Los Rios province, Ecuador, Jan-Jun 2026 records
what_we_add: 29 of 66 one-bidder works tenders (44%) in Los Rios, highest of 24 provinces (coastal town halls elsewhere 15%, Guayas 21%); $13.4M of $28.8M, $6.3M in one Quevedo contract
why: CONNECTAS (42.6% of Ecuador's tenders had one bidder over six years) and Open Contracting (single-bid share 20.5% by mid-2022) report the same finding nationally. Neither names Los Rios, Quevedo or any 2026 tender.
